name: Millennium Online Solutions (India) Limited
about: Millennium Online Solutions (India) Limited engages in the provision of various services relating to computer electronics, hardware and its peripherals India. The company was formerly known as Mahamaya Investments Limited and changed its name to Millennium Online Solutions (India) Limited in June 2013. Millennium Online Solutions (India) Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Surat, India.
